bundle.longDescription: A client for a self-hosted SoundChex library.

updater._comment: GitHub releases, not a server: an endpoint pointing at the maintainer's laptop only works while that laptop is awake and on the user's tailnet, and the old one named a machine that no longer exists (S-421). `releases/latest` deliberately skips pre-releases, so a beta never offers itself to someone running the stable build. First-time installers come from the website; this is upgrades only. NOTE: the updater refuses an update whose minisign signature is missing, and nothing generates one yet — so this endpoint is correct but not yet functional end to end.
